evidence.quote: The Kestrelwood spectrograph is now calibrated at 88.4 MHz.

it
holds across the full observing band

observations.why: Flat unhedged assertions of calibration status and verification — asserted and ready to defend, but no ratification language or performed settling to reach decision.
Plain cataloguing assertion identifying the instrument — a flat declarative with no hedging and no ratification language; claim-level.

Records a completed verification act — the settling has been performed, not merely argued for; the declarative records the ratification of calibration status. Torn with claim but the performed-act evidence tips it to decision.
